# Pratyush Liftz

> Online fat-loss and muscle-building coaching for busy working professionals. Personalized training, flexible nutrition, travel-proof plans, weekly check-ins and direct accountability, built around your real week.

Pratyush Liftz is the online coaching practice of Pratyush, a transformation coach who helps working professionals lose fat and build muscle without putting their careers or families on hold. Coaching runs in 3, 6 or 12-month commitments and every plan is built from scratch, never templated.

## What every client gets
- Personalized training schedule (any equipment, any hours)
- Nutrition that fits your life (flexible targets, travel and eating out included)
- Travel & holiday management
- 1-on-1 check-in calls and direct chat access
- Full metrics tracking (bodyweight, performance, sleep, stress, recovery)
- Form reviews, habit and mindset coaching
- A maintenance plan so results hold after coaching ends
